final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT batting_hand, award_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT batting_hand, award_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
